chmmc-2013-tiebreaker-01.prompt: In the diagram, point $A$ lies on the circle centered at $O$. $AB$ is tangent to circle $O$ with $AB=6$. Point $C$ is $\frac{2\pi}{3}$ radians away from point $A$ on the circle, with $BC$ intersecting circle $O$ at point $D$. The length of $BD$ is $3$. Compute the radius of the circle.

chmmc-2013-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Suppose the roots of $$x^4-3x^2+6x-12=1$$ are $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ and $\delta$. What is the value of $$\frac{\alpha+\beta+\gamma}{\delta^2}+\frac{\alpha+\delta+\gamma}{\beta^2}+\frac{\alpha+\beta+\delta}{\gamma^2}+\frac{\delta+\beta+\gamma}{\alpha^2}\,?$$
chmmc-2013-tiebreaker-02.reviewNote: Official key answers -1/2, which solves x^4-3x^2+6x-12=0 and ignores the '=1' on the right-hand side; the printed equation is x^4-3x^2+6x-13=0, giving -6/13.

chmmc-2013-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Bill plays a game in which he rolls two fair standard six-sided dice with sides labeled one through six. He wins if the number on one of the dice is three times the number on the other die. If Bill plays this game three times, compute the probability that he wins at least once.

chmmc-2013-tiebreaker-04.reviewNote: Official key says 449/720, which does not follow from its own computation (8/3 - 1 - 1/270 = 449/270).
